reviewContext.userProblem: Passing two files to chilla at launch (for example `chilla before.png after.png`) only shows them as a sidebar list with one viewer, so before/after files cannot be compared side by side.
requiredOutcomes: `chilla before.png after.png` shows the two images side by side, first argument left, second right.
Two markdown/text files are also shown side by side using the existing renderers (WorkspaceDocumentColumn -> PreviewPane and friends).
Each pane has an eye icon at its top-left; hiding one pane gives the other the full width apart from a narrow restore strip; the hidden pane can be restored and both panes can never be hidden.
0, 1, or 3+ file arguments, directory or mixed directory+file arguments, and GitHub/Git-diff targets behave exactly as before (`a b a` stays an explicit file set).
Rust and TypeScript unit tests cover argument classification (pair vs list), the file_pair payload normalizer, and pane visibility state; a hidden pair pane ignores +/- zoom shortcuts.

CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true cargo clippy, cargo nextest, bun run typecheck, bun run test, bun run test:dom and biome pass; the reconcile phase launches target/debug/chilla with two image files per chilla-post-edit-launch.
nonGoals: No new Tauri command; list_explicit_file_set, directory_listing.rs, commands/document.rs and lib.rs are unchanged.
macOS Finder / Apple Event open-files and startupContextForPickedTarget never produce file_pair.
No pane resizing, eye-toggle keyboard shortcut, synchronized scroll/zoom, per-pane file watching, editing, TOC or file browser sidebar in pair view.
No edits to src/features/workspace/WorkspaceDocumentColumn.tsx (pre-existing uncommitted user diff, 2+/2-), WorkspaceHeader.tsx, App.css, package.json or bun.lock.

constraints: Exactly two positional file arguments that resolve to two distinct canonical regular files trigger pair view; classification uses P (positional count) and U (unique count): U==1 -> File, P==2 && U==2 -> FilePair, otherwise U>=2 -> FileSet.
Directory rejection text, exit code 2, the non-regular-file error, first-occurrence dedup and Git-diff precedence are unchanged.
Rust and TypeScript sides of the startup payload contract (BrowserRoot file_pair) change together across pair-view-rust-startup and pair-view-workspace-integration.
Reuse existing renderers; no duplicated viewers; inline SVG glyphs only; no emojis.
Follow AGENTS.md, rust-coding-standards and ts-coding-standards; CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true for cargo commands.

Each worker edits only its plan's writePaths, records pre/post sha256 for edited existing files, and appends to its own plan progress log; evidence goes under tmp/pair-view-20261115-01/<planId>/<attempt>/ (untracked, data only).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: New StartupTarget::FilePair { left, right } and BrowserRoot::FilePair { left_file_path, right_file_path } serialized as kind "file_pair" with initial_mode file_view.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: A distinct variant keeps explicit_file_set semantics untouched and lets exhaustive matches on both Rust and TS sides surface every consumer (design-pair-view.md Startup Payload Contract).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Classify on P and U, not on U==2 alone.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: `a b a` (P=3, U=2) must keep the explicit file-set list, matching the constraint that 3+ arguments behave as before.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: PairView renders each pane through the existing WorkspaceDocumentColumn with markdownDoc=null and an openFilePreview result.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Reuses image, markdown, text, PDF, media and CSV renderers without duplication and without editing the user-modified WorkspaceDocumentColumn.tsx.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Visibility is a three-state machine (both, left_only, right_only); hiding the only visible pane is a no-op and a restore strip is always rendered for the hidden side.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Makes the both-hidden state unrepresentable and guarantees a recovery control.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Hidden panes stay mounted with the hidden attribute; PreviewPane keydown gets a closest('.pane--hidden, [hidden], [aria-hidden=true]') guard.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Preserves per-pane zoom/scroll across hide/restore and matches existing PdfFilePreviewPane/MediaFilePreviewPane guards so +/- does not zoom a hidden pane.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Pair mode reuses the existing workspace__body--viewer--no-tree grid and leaves header single-document toggles hidden via null md()/fp().
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Avoids App.css and WorkspaceHeader.tsx edits; full-width behavior is confirmed in the launched app.

intentionalTradeoffs: Fixed 50/50 split with no resize handle (qa-pair-view.md default).
Pair view is CLI-launch only; open-files with two files still yields an explicit file set.
Reload re-opens both panes manually; no file watching.
jsdom cannot confirm layout width or concurrent media playback; these are confirmed only by the GUI launch check, which depends on the environment.
supportedEdgeCases: `a b a` -> FileSet([a,b]); `a b c` -> FileSet([a,b,c]).
`--verbose a b` and `--csv-first-row-header=true a b` -> FilePair (options do not count toward P); file_open_options pass through.
`dir file` -> existing usage error with exit code 2; `<git_dir> <commit>` stays a Git-diff target.
One pane failing to load shows its error while the other pane renders.
Hidden pane ignores +/- zoom; restored pane keeps its pre-hide zoom.
Reload in pair mode re-requests both previews; file-tree toggle and other directory shortcuts are inert in pair mode.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: macOS Apple Event open-files delivering exactly two files.
Live updates when a paired file changes on disk.
Pair view for directories or more than two files.
